name: block_deal_momentum_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Block deals on NSE (trades > 5 lakh shares or ₹10 crore, executed in a separate window 08:45-09:00 or during market hours in 15-min blocks) signal large institutional position changes. When a block deal occurs at a premium to the previous close, it signals institutional buying conviction; when at a discount, selling pressure. The stock subsequently drifts in the block deal direction over the next 1-2 hours as: (1) information about the block deal disseminates (NSE discloses block deals with a 15-min delay), (2) other institutions follow the signal, (3) retail traders notice the unusual volume and pile in. The inefficiency exists because block deal data is disclosed with a lag, and most retail traders don't monitor the block deal window.
universe: All NSE stocks eligible for block deals
stock_filter: Stock must have a block deal today, ADV > ₹10 crore, price > ₹100
session: 09:15-12:00 IST (block deal momentum fades by midday)

other: NSE block deal disclosures (via NSE bulk/block deal API)

conditions: block_premium_pct > 1.0 (block deal at 1%+ premium — bullish signal)
block_size_relative > 0.5 (deal size > 50% of ADV — meaningful size)
long.confirmation: close > VWAP AND close > open_today after block deal disclosure

conditions: block_premium_pct < -1.0 (block deal at 1%+ discount — bearish signal)
short.confirmation: close < VWAP AND close < open_today after block deal disclosure

entry.entry_price: market order 15-20 min after block deal disclosure (let initial reaction settle)

exit.time_stop: exit by 12:00 IST (drift fades by midday)
exit.eod_rule: flatten by 12:00 IST (not EOD — this is a morning strategy)

filters.time_filter: entry only after block deal disclosure + 15 min settling period
filters.trend_filter: prefer block deal direction aligned with NIFTY 50 trend
filters.spread_filter: bid-ask < 10 bps (block deal stocks can have temporarily wide spreads)
filters.event_filter: skip if stock also has earnings/corporate action today (confounding signals)
other_filters: skip if block_size_relative < 0.5 (too small to be meaningful)
skip if block deal is between group companies (not arms-length)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — block deal data is public but the 15-min disclosure delay creates an information asymmetry window. Faster data access (direct NSE feed) would reduce the edge for slower participants.

weaknesses: Block deals happen irregularly — some days have zero, others have 5+. The strategy has highly variable daily P&L and long idle periods.
Block deals between promoter entities or for regulatory compliance (SEBI MPS norms) don't signal genuine institutional conviction and create false signals.
The 15-minute disclosure delay means by the time we see the data and confirm, the initial momentum may already be exhausted, leaving only residual drift.
prior_art: Holthausen, Leftwich & Mayers (1990) 'Large-Block Transactions, the Speed of Response'. Saar (2001) 'Price Impact Asymmetry of Block Trades'. In India, SEBI circular on block deal framework (2017) defines the mechanism. Banerjee & Ghosh (2019) study NSE block deals.
notes: Monitor NSE's block deal disclosures via their website API or scraping. The pre-open block deal window (08:45-09:00) is especially informative — deals in this window are visible before market open, giving an early signal for the day's direction. Bulk deals (different from block deals, disclosed T+1) are not useful for intraday.
